Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT, Construcții și Dezvoltare de software
Overview 
 As a QA Lead at GRAITEC, you will lead the quality strategy and execution across our desktop, web, API, and cloud-connected software solutions. You will be responsible for ensuring that quality is embedded throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through delivery and production support.
 You will lead and mentor Manual and Automation QA teams, driving a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and accountability. Working closely with Product Managers, Developers, DevOps, and other stakeholders, you will define testing strategies, oversee release quality, and ensure the effective adoption of test automation and modern Quality Engineering practices.
 Given that more than 50% of GRAITEC's products are desktop-based, strong experience with desktop application testing and automation is essential. You will help shape scalable testing frameworks, improve CI/CD quality gates, and ensure consistent quality standards across multiple products and technology platforms.
 This role offers the opportunity to influence quality at both operational and strategic levels, contributing to automation excellence, quality governance, team growth, and the adoption of emerging technologies such as AI-assisted testing and predictive quality analytics.
 Key Responsibilities 
Lead and mentor Manual and Automation QA teams.
Define and execute QA strategies, standards, and best practices.
Drive automation initiatives across desktop, web, API, and integration testing.
Ensure quality validation is integrated into CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
Monitor quality KPIs, defect trends, and release readiness.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams to improve product quality.
Drive continuous improvement, test optimization, and quality transformation initiatives.
Support the adoption of AI-assisted testing and modern Quality Engineering practices.
Act as a quality champion across the organization, promoting a quality-first mindset.
Support release planning activities and risk assessments to ensure successful product delivery.
Coach and develop QA team members through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development initiatives.
 Qualifications 
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong technical leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Deep understanding of QA processes, test automation, release management, and quality metrics.
Experience working within Agile software development environments.
Professional working proficiency in English.
 Requirements 
7+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance.
2+ years of experience as a QA Lead, Test Lead, or in a technical QA leadership role.
Strong experience in test automation, including designing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing frameworks.
Hands-on experience with automation technologies and scripting/programming languages such as C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar .
Experience driving automation strategy and increasing automation coverage across multiple products.
Strong experience testing desktop applications .
Experience with automated testing of desktop, web, API, and integration layers .
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
Experience with API testing tools and frameworks such as Postman, Rest Assured, or similar .
Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and Quality Engineering practices .
Experience defining test strategies, quality metrics, release readiness criteria, and quality governance processes.
Experience collaborating with Development, Product Management, and DevOps teams in fast-paced software environments.
Strong technical leadership, communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to balance strategic quality initiatives with hands-on technical involvement.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with CAD, BIM, 3D, Engineering, or Construction software.
Experience with Azure or cloud-based platforms.
Experience with performance, scalability, or reliability testing.
Experience with AI-assisted testing, intelligent automation, or predictive quality analytics.
ISTQB Advanced Certification or equivalent.
 At Graitec, we’re proud to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace. 
 We value our employees for who they are and the contributions they bring, encouraging everyone to be their authentic selves at work. This diversity helps us better serve the wide range of customers and markets we operate in. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and assess candidates solely on their skills and ability to succeed in the role.
 Graitec uses AI to support and streamline internal processes; however, all application reviews, screening, and
 hiring decisions are made solely by our Talent Acquisition team and hiring managers.
 HR Screening – An initial “get to know you” discussion.
 Technical Assessment Interview – May include a presentation or a collaborative exercise.
 Hiring Manager Interview – A role-specific discussion with the hiring manager.
 Final Interview – Conversation with the Business Unit Leader.
